document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Walking through the meadowland with an eye for a trophy to 
take back home, your group is startled by a vast shadow that 
glides across the grass around you. You glance up, imagining 
from its vast wingspan that it might be a surviving giant condor. 
It is not a condor.

Make  a  Sanity  roll:  if  you  fail,  lose  1D6  Sanity;  if  you  retain 
control, go to 631. If you suffer temporary insanity, go to 646. If you 
suffer indefinite insanity, go to 364.
